title: World Bloom — With You at SEKAI's Beginnings — Episode1 Reaching Out to Feelings

meta.Event Outline: From their space between worlds, Miku and the others watch over everyone. Just then, a fragment appears before them. It takes them to see everyone at the moment their true feelings were born.

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, welcome!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I didn't realize you were here.
Thank you for always watching over everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The others are here with me today, so why don't we all chat for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hiya!
Hehe. I'm so glad you're here♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We were actually just talking about everyone's SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Did you know that they've been changing bit by bit lately?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it seems that new areas and little sprouts have been appearing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Is that because everyone's been growing so much?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Probably.
They've all experienced quite a lot up to this point.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, they have.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Four set out to become professional musicians and have made big strides in their journey...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Some are working hard as idols each day in order to spread hope to as many people as they can...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Others overcame a series of walls and obstacles on their way to surpassing that legendary night...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: One group even set out to perform at new and different places in order to make their dreams a reality...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And some have come face to face with tough facts as they try to find their true selves.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All of them discovered their true feelings, experienced many things and felt a myriad of different emotions...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Those thoughts and feelings have begun to change each SEKAI little by little.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Hey, something over there is twinkling...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
Could it be a fragment of somebody's feelings?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But it doesn't look like any ordinary fragment...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Could it be that the SEKAI are trying to tell us something...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If so, I'd like to try touching it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Me too!
I can't wait to find out what sorts of feelings it represents♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me neither. Especially if it has something to do with all the others!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would you like to join us?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, let's go...!
